The weighted campus energy balance calculator passed all tests with a perfect verifier reward, demonstrating a robust implementation of the core logic.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.73 across one trial with zero exceptions. Pytest reported 100% success in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite within 0.31 seconds. While the logic is reusable, the lower judge reward suggests potential for improvement in code documentation or edge-case handling beyond the primary success path.
